data.overview: A shy Danish bodybuilder, discouraged by years of loneliness and hemmed in by his overprotective mother, travels to Thailand hoping to find a wife. The journey instead asks him to speak honestly about the life and connection he wants.
data.tagline: The longest journey begins with a hello.
